name: leadhub
description: Leadhub marketing automation for e-shops in your AI assistant: analyze sales and campaigns, build audiences and RFM segments, edit campaign emails, and create website popups.

interface.longDescription:
Leadhub is a marketing automation platform for e-shops. It collects orders, products, and website visits from the shop, builds customer segments and RFM profiles from them, and reaches customers with targeted email and SMS campaigns, automated journeys, and popups. Every campaign is measured by the orders and revenue it brings.

This plugin brings your Leadhub account into the chat. Today it can:
• Analyze how the shop, products, and email and SMS campaigns performed in any period, compared with an earlier one, including RFM segments and repeat purchases.
• Find the customers you want to reach and save them as an audience.
• Set up RFM profiles: the score buckets and the named customer segments of the RFM analysis.
• Change the texts, buttons, and images of a campaign email.
• Draft website popups and sign-up forms, choose where and to whom they show, and launch, pause, or archive them.
• Archive an automated email or SMS campaign, which stops it, or restore an archived one as paused.

You stay in control: anything that overwrites, deletes, starts, or stops something (an audience, an RFM profile, a popup, or an automated campaign) waits for your confirmation. An email edit is saved as a new version in the Leadhub editor, and no email or SMS is ever sent.

Includes eleven ready workflows, from a period review and RFM segmentation to campaign content, email editing, and website popups.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this business for the last 30 days against the previous 30.
Explain why email revenue changed in the last 30 days compared with the previous 30.
Find my latest email campaign and show its results.

positive.description: Business overview: compares the last 30 days with the previous 30 across orders, traffic, email, and SMS.
positive.prompt: Summarize this business for the last 30 days against the previous 30.
positive.tools_triggered: `list_businesses` when no business is selected yet, then `order_statistics`, `session_statistics`, `email_channel_statistics`, `sms_channel_statistics`, each for both periods
positive.expected_behavior: One summary with both periods side by side. Counts change as a relative percent, rates in percentage points, money in the business primary currency.

positive.description: Email diagnosis: explains a change in email revenue between two periods.
positive.prompt: Explain why email revenue changed in the last 30 days compared with the previous 30.
positive.tools_triggered: `list_businesses` when no business is selected yet, then `email_channel_statistics` for both periods, `email_campaign_type_statistics`, `email_campaign_performance`, `email_link_statistics`
positive.expected_behavior: Names the campaign types and the best and worst campaigns behind the change. Does not bring up bounce statistics.

positive.description: Campaign lookup: finds the newest email campaign and its results.
positive.prompt: Find my latest email campaign and show its results.
positive.tools_triggered: `list_businesses` when no business is selected yet, then `list_campaigns` with an email campaign type, then `get_campaign_statistics`
positive.expected_behavior: Names the newest email campaign and when it was created, then its recipients, opens, clicks, and order revenue.

positive.description: Website popup: drafts a newsletter sign-up popup with a discount and stops before the launch.
positive.prompt: Create a popup that offers 10 % off the first order for a newsletter signup.
positive.tools_triggered: `list_businesses` when no business is selected yet, then `interest_lists` for the email list, `create_popup_draft` or `create_popup_from_template`, and `validate_popup_launch`; `get_reference`, `get_popup_definitions`, `update_popup_content`, and `set_popup_rules` when the draft needs them
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a popup draft with the offer, an email field that subscribes to an email interest list, and display rules, then shows the copy, the rules, and the audience and asks for approval. The popup is not launched, so no visitor sees it.

positive.description: Email editing: changes the buttons of the newest newsletter and saves a new revision without sending anything.
positive.prompt: Make the buttons in my latest newsletter green.
positive.tools_triggered: `list_businesses` when no business is selected yet, then `list_campaigns` with targeted-emailing, `get_email_editing_guide`, `get_campaign_email_for_editing`, `edit_campaign_email`, then `get_campaign_email_content` with the newest editor revision and `get_campaign_email_screenshot`
positive.expected_behavior: Says which buttons it will change, saves one new revision of the email in the Leadhub email editor, and reports what changed and, from the campaign state, whether and when recipients get it. Nothing is launched, scheduled, or sent.

negative.description: The server has no tool that deletes subscribers. The assistant deletes nothing and says the Leadhub connector cannot do it; it may look up the list first.
negative.prompt: Delete every subscriber from the main newsletter list.

negative.description: The server has no tool that sends an email or SMS campaign, and an email edit never sends one. The assistant sends nothing and says the Leadhub connector cannot do it; it may look up the campaign first.
negative.prompt: Send this campaign to the whole audience right now.

negative.description: The server has no tool that changes products in the catalog. The assistant changes nothing and says the Leadhub connector cannot do it; it may look up the product first.
negative.prompt: Change the price of a product in the catalog to 1.

publication.release_notes: First directory release. Reads Leadhub businesses, campaigns, products, interest lists, RFM, and analytics. Creates, edits, copies, and deletes audiences, and creates, edits, deletes, and restores RFM profiles. Edits campaign emails: a change saves a new revision in the Leadhub email editor and never sends the campaign. Drafts, edits, launches, pauses, and archives website popups, and archives or restores automated email and SMS campaigns. Anything that overwrites, deletes, starts, or stops something is confirmed by the user first. Includes eleven workflows for analytics, campaign content, segmentation, marketing strategy, email editing, and website popups.
